winConditions.title: Take All Prize Cards
text: Each player starts with 6 face-down Prize cards. Every time you Knock Out an opponent's Pokemon, you take 1 Prize card into your hand (2 for Pokemon ex/V/GX, 3 for VMAX/TAG TEAM/Mega ex).
The first player to take all 6 of their Prize cards wins the game. This is the primary win condition.

winConditions.title: No Pokemon in Play
text: If your opponent has no Pokemon left in play (no Active Pokemon and no Benched Pokemon), you immediately win the game.
This typically happens when their last Pokemon is Knocked Out and they have no Bench replacements.

winConditions.title: Empty Deck at Start of Turn
text: If your opponent has no cards left in their deck at the beginning of their turn and cannot draw a card, you win the game.
Note: losing the ability to draw due to a card effect during your turn does not cause a loss.

winConditions.title: Concession
text: Either player may concede at any time. Announce your concession and you lose immediately.
